name: german-credit-benchmark
description: Benchmark based on the UCI German Credit dataset that measures models' ability to predict creditworthiness (good vs. bad credit) from demographic and financial features. Commonly used for binary classification, risk assessment, calibration and fairness studies. Evaluation focuses on predictive performance and related fairness/robustness analyses.
reputation: A long‑standing, widely used classical benchmark in academic research for credit scoring and fairness evaluation.
